stageNotes.name: After Effects
stageNotes.parse: Inspect parseState; missing dependencies can block
stageNotes.edit: Exposed fields; supported revision layer/slot edits
stageNotes.export: Files declared by the template outputs
stageNotes.evidence: Customer template rendering is documented; this mapping run starts no renders.

stageNotes.name: Photoshop / Illustrator
stageNotes.upload: Accepted source files; EPS is Library intake
stageNotes.parse: Source-specific import; inspect the actual result
stageNotes.edit: Only the fields/layers the imported revision exposes
stageNotes.preview: Library preview or supported template preview
stageNotes.render: Only after a usable template is published
stageNotes.export: Declared output files; no promise of PSD/AI round-trip
stageNotes.evidence: Upload is documented. Arbitrary-file fidelity and end-to-end rendering are not established by this map.

stageNotes.name: Presentations
stageNotes.edit: No presentation-specific action in the captured Forge surface
stageNotes.render: No general deck-render action documented here
stageNotes.export: Original download; do not infer PPTX/PDF generation
stageNotes.evidence: Library support does not establish an agent authoring/export workflow.

stageNotes.name: Premiere Pro
stageNotes.parse: Not a template family in the captured source contract
stageNotes.evidence: A project file and a rendered movie are different resources.

stageNotes.name: HTML / HyperFrames
stageNotes.parse: Native source; inspect family and parseState
stageNotes.edit: Only the native contract’s exposed fields
stageNotes.preview: Source/Library preview does not certify rendered frames
stageNotes.render: Use only the execution path exposed for that source
stageNotes.export: Only artifacts returned by that path
stageNotes.evidence: Does not enter template_forge. Browser/native rendering fidelity is not qualified by this documentation run.

stageNotes.name: Web components
stageNotes.upload: ZIP with a recognized component manifest
stageNotes.export: Returned artifacts, not arbitrary source conversion
stageNotes.evidence: Does not enter template_forge. A generic ZIP is not automatically a component.

stageNotes.name: Blender / scenes
stageNotes.upload: Library source; accessible scenes come from scenes
stageNotes.edit: scene_fill values, not unrestricted scene editing
stageNotes.preview: Review filled values; this is not a pixel preview
stageNotes.export: Scene results in Library; use scene history
stageNotes.evidence: Does not enter template_forge. No arbitrary customer-scene fidelity claim.

stageNotes.name: Figma / Canva
stageNotes.parse: Connected import is separate from file intake
stageNotes.edit: No dedicated action in the captured Forge pair
stageNotes.preview: Do not infer from connection availability
stageNotes.render: No general execution recipe verified here
stageNotes.evidence: A connection or source-family enum alone is not an executable function.

stageNotes.name: CAD / 3D model files
stageNotes.upload: Library model intake; CAD has separate tools
stageNotes.parse: Use the CAD capability guide for CAD resources
stageNotes.preview: Model viewer does not establish CAD rendering
stageNotes.export: Separate CAD artifacts; no manufacturing qualification implied
stageNotes.evidence: Adjacent interface, not a Forge render-set family. Inspect help_describe before use.

stageNotes.name: Fonts
stageNotes.render: Required faces can block template rendering
stageNotes.export: Do not assume fonts can be downloaded or redistributed
stageNotes.evidence: Brand typography names do not prove the required font bytes are available.

stageNotes.name: Other design files
stageNotes.render: Only if an executable template is separately discovered
stageNotes.evidence: Library preview strategies are not Forge renderer qualification.

stageNotes.name: Media, documents and other files
stageNotes.parse: Document/media classification is not template parsing
stageNotes.preview: Depends on media format and proxy availability
stageNotes.render: No template engine implied by storage
stageNotes.evidence: Store source identity and version IDs; refresh short-lived signed URLs as needed.
